name: io.github.danbenba/dokploy-mcp
description: Run your self-hosted Dokploy panel from Claude or ChatGPT: projects, apps, compose, databases, domains, deployments and logs.
title: Dokploy MCP

environmentVariables.name: DOKPLOY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your Dokploy panel, for example https://panel.example.com

environmentVariables.name: DOKPLOY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key generated in Dokploy under Settings then API Keys. Several keys separated by commas reach several organizations.

environmentVariables.name: DOKPLOY_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma separated list among read, deploy, create, delete, admin. Every scope when omitted.
